# Mungale Eye Hospital

> Specialist eye hospital in Kothi, Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Founded 2007.
> Led by ophthalmologists Dr. Sachin Mungale (MS — Ophthalmology) and
> Dr. Meeta Mungale (MS — Ophthalmology, DNB). Referral centre for cornea
> and glaucoma care.

## Contact

- Address: 2nd Floor, Vinraj Plaza, opp. Government Press, Kothi Road, Anandpura, Vadodara, Gujarat 390001, India
- Phone: +91 8140050055, +91 0265-2430101
- Emergency: +91 8140250055, +91 9723311209
- WhatsApp: +91 8140250055
- Email: mungaleeyehospital@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–8:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Website: https://mungaleeyehospital.com

## Services

- Cataract Surgery (phacoemulsification, lens implants)
- Cornea Evaluation and Corneal Treatments (infections, injuries, transplants)
- Glaucoma Evaluation and Glaucoma Treatments (drops, laser, surgery)
- Optical & Contact Lenses
